title: What to Monitor: Four Golden Signals

scenes.say: If you're launching a new app, what should you actually monitor? Let's break down the golden signals that every engineer should know.

scenes.label: Latency
scenes.sub: How fast does your app respond to users?
scenes.say: First up, latency. This is how quickly your app responds. Users notice when things get slow.
The four golden signals are latency, traffic, errors, and saturation. Together, they show how your system is really doing.

scenes.label: Host Health
scenes.sub: Check if servers are up, disk space, certs, backups
scenes.say: Don't forget the basics: is the server up, is there enough disk space, are certificates and backups good?

scenes.question: What should you alert on first?
scenes.right: User-facing issues, like errors or slowdowns
scenes.say: Here's a common trap: alerting on CPU spikes. It's better to alert on what users actually feel, like errors or slow response times.
